name: listing-browser
purpose: The full, browsable listing of a page such as the Careers jobs list: a headline over a toolbar (a search field, one select per facet and one for the order) and every row under its group, as a table from the small breakpoint up and as a list of items below it, with an empty state when nothing matches. Search, facets and order are local state over the rows the page carries; a facet is seeded from `?<key>=` in the URL when the value is one the page offers. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'listing-browser', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `input`, `select`, `table`, `item`, `empty-state` and `button` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: For a listing a reader narrows by text and by a few facets, such as open positions grouped by department.
When every row links to its own page and the listing fits in the page JSON.
avoidWhen: For a short, unfiltered preview of the same rows → use `listing-table`.
For a data table with sorting, selection and pagination inside the product → use `table`.
For a grid of linked topic cards → use `subject-library`.
related: table` — the composed rows and cells the listing renders from the small breakpoint up.
item` — the list rows the listing renders below the small breakpoint.
empty-state` — the state shown when the search and facets match nothing.
bestPractices: Name the first column after what the row is (`Role`); it is the row's link, and the second column describes the row on phones.
Give every row the facet values it carries under the facet's `key`, so the selects narrow it.
Keep `groups` in the order the reader scans; rows of a group not listed there are not shown.
Make the first entry of `sorts` the order the page is authored in, with an empty `by`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page `id` of the band, the target of a `#hash` link.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline over the listing, rendered by the section title as its `h2` and naming the band.

props.name: columns
props.doc: The columns, left to right; each is `{ key, label, grow?, align? }`. The first names the row and links it, the second describes it on phones.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Every row, in source order; each is `{ href, group, values, facets }` where `values` and `facets` are keyed by column and facet.

props.name: groups
props.doc: The groups the rows are listed under, in order; a group with no matching row is not shown.

props.name: facets
props.doc: The facet selects; each is `{ key, label, allLabel, options }` where `key` matches a row facet and seeds it from `?key=` in the URL, and every option is `{ value, label }`.

props.name: sorts
props.doc: The orders, the first the default; each is `{ value, label, by? }` where `by` is the column it sorts on and an empty `by` keeps the source order.

props.name: sortAriaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the order select.

props.name: search
props.doc: The search field; `{ placeholder, shortPlaceholder, label }` where `shortPlaceholder` is used below the large breakpoint and `label` names the field. Omitted when absent.

props.name: empty
props.doc: The state shown when nothing matches; `{ title, description, clearLabel }` where `clearLabel` is the button that clears the search and every facet. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import ListingBrowser from '@aziontech/webkit/listing-browser'
</script>

<template>
  <ListingBrowser
    title="Open positions"
    :columns="[
      { key: 'role', label: 'Role', grow: 2 },
      { key: 'team', label: 'Team and location', grow: 2 },
      { key: 'type', label: 'Work type', align: 'end' }
    ]"
    :rows="[
      {
        href: '/careers/software-engineer-go',
        group: 'Engineering',
        values: {
          role: 'Software Engineer (Go)',
          team: 'Engineering · San Francisco',
          type: 'Hybrid · Full-time'
        },
        facets: { area: ['Engineering'], location: ['San Francisco'] }
      },
      {
        href: '/careers/grc-analyst',
        group: 'Security',
        values: {
          role: 'GRC Analyst (Governance, Risk & Compliance)',
          team: 'Compliance and Corporate IT · San Francisco / New York',
          type: 'Hybrid · Full-time'
        },
        facets: { area: ['Security'], location: ['San Francisco', 'New York'] }
      }
    ]"
    :groups="['Engineering', 'Security']"
    :facets="[
      {
        key: 'area',
        label: 'Department',
        allLabel: 'All departments',
        options: [
          { value: 'Engineering', label: 'Engineering' },
          { value: 'Security', label: 'Security' }
        ]
      },
      {
        key: 'location',
        label: 'Location',
        allLabel: 'All locations',
        options: [
          { value: 'New York', label: 'New York, United States' },
          { value: 'San Francisco', label: 'San Francisco, United States' }
        ]
      }
    ]"
    :sorts="[
      { value: 'newest', label: 'Newest posted', by: '' },
      { value: 'title', label: 'Title (A–Z)', by: 'role' }
    ]"
    sort-aria-label="Sort positions"
    :search="{
      placeholder: 'Search by title, team, or location',
      shortPlaceholder: 'Search positions',
      label: 'Search positions'
    }"
    :empty="{
      title: 'Nothing here yet',
      description: 'No open positions match your search.',
      clearLabel: 'View all open positions'
    }"
  />
</template>
